nodes.description: VampireAdapter.rewardToken(Victim): staticcalls rewardToken() on the supplied victim and abi.decodes an IERC20 from the raw return data.
VampireAdapter.poolCount(Victim): staticcalls poolCount() on the supplied victim and returns the decoded uint256.
VampireAdapter.sellableRewardAmount(Victim): staticcalls sellableRewardAmount() on the supplied victim and returns the decoded uint256.
VampireAdapter.sellRewardForWeth(Victim,uint256,address): delegatecalls sellRewardForWeth(address,uint256,address) on the caller-supplied victim address.
VampireAdapter.lockableToken(Victim,uint256): staticcalls lockableToken(uint256) on the victim for a given poolId.
VampireAdapter.lockedAmount(Victim,uint256): staticcalls lockedAmount(address,uint256) impersonating address(this) as the account.
VampireAdapter.deposit(Victim,uint256,uint256): delegatecalls deposit(address,uint256,uint256) on the caller-supplied victim address.
VampireAdapter.withdraw(Victim,uint256,uint256): delegatecalls withdraw(address,uint256,uint256) on the caller-supplied victim address.
VampireAdapter.claimReward(Victim,uint256): delegatecalls claimReward(address,uint256) on the caller-supplied victim address.
VampireAdapter.emergencyWithdraw(Victim,uint256): delegatecalls emergencyWithdraw(address,uint256) on the caller-supplied victim address.
VampireAdapter.poolAddress(Victim,uint256): staticcalls poolAddress(uint256) on the victim and decodes an address.
VampireAdapter.rewardToWethPool(Victim): staticcalls rewardToWethPool() on the victim and decodes an address.
